Did Iran cut Pakistan's internet cables? Internet services across parts of Pakistan were disrupted after a fault was reported in the SMW5 international submarine cable system, around 11 kilometres off Pakistan's coast. Pakistan's Telecommunications Authority (PTA) says the cause of the fault remains unknown, and there is no evidence linking Iran to the incident.
However, the outage comes amid growing concerns over Iran's threats to target undersea internet cables in the Persian Gulf if the United States and Israel launch fresh military strikes against Tehran.
